title: Rocks, Pebbles and Sand: Modality-aware Scheduling for Multimodal Large Language Model Inference
abstract: arXiv:2603.26498v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) power platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot, enabling rich interactions across text, images, and videos. Unlike text-only workloads, multimodal requests are inherently heterogeneous, differing by orders of magnitude in latency and memory footprint. Existing LLM serving systems, designed for homogeneous text workloads, struggle under this heterogeneity: large image and video requests monopolize GPU resources, causing severe head-of-line blocking and degrading the responsiveness of lightweight, latency-critical text queries. Recent multimodal serving systems mitigate this interference through disaggregation, isolating encoding and inference stages across GPUs. While effective at large scale, such designs introduce severe GPU underutilization in more practical, moderate-scale deployments. translated_title: 石头、鹅卵石与沙子：面向多模态大语言模型推理的模态感知调度
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）为ChatGPT、Gemini和Copilot等平台提供支持，实现了跨文本、图像和视频的丰富交互。与纯文本工作负载不同，多模态请求本质上是异构的，在延迟和内存占用方面相差数个数量级。为同构文本工作负载设计的现有LLM服务系统在这种异构性下举步维艰：大型图像和视频请求垄断GPU资源，造成严重的队头阻塞，降低了轻量级、延迟敏感的文本查询的响应速度。近期的一些多模态服务系统通过分离式架构缓解了这种干扰，将编码和推理阶段隔离在不同的GPU上运行。虽然这种设计在大规模部署中有效，但在更贴近实际的中小规模部署中却会导致严重的GPU利用率不足。为此，我们构建了RPS-Serve——一种模态感知调度框架，它利用极端的……
tldr: 针对多模态大语言模型服务中异构请求导致的队头阻塞和GPU利用率低下问题，本文提出模态感知调度框架RPS-Serve，无需分离式部署即可兼顾大规模视频请求与低延迟文本查询的性能。
en_tdlr: RPS-Serve is a modality-aware scheduling framework that mitigates head-of-line blocking and GPU underutilization in multimodal LLM inference caused by heterogeneous requests, without relying on large-scale disaggregated deployments.
